name: Bahadir Kimya
summary: Founded in 1974 and headquartered in Yahsihan, Turkey, Bahadir Kimya Sanayi Ve Ticaret AS focuses on the production and distribution of chemical solutions, primarily serving the automotive sector. Their extensive product line features a wide array of lubricants for various applications, including passenger cars, light and heavy-duty commercial vehicles, motorcycles, and industrial equipment, alongside specialized transmission and differential fluids, and greases. Additionally, the company provides aerosol sprays and a selection of other niche chemical offerings.
